label: research-events-fixed-n2
_why: BATCH A of the corrections ruled 2026-08-12, after session 20260812_010659 was annotated PARTIALLY VOID (see its VERDICT.md). Two changes, together: (1) the military journal entries' second term now carries the SAME gate as the first — front-restricted, one general with >=100 mobilised battalions or two with >=50, plus a >=50% mobilised share — instead of firing on `is_at_war` alone, which made it complete in 13 weeks of any war against a more advanced enemy; (2) TECH_AHEAD_OF_TIME_PENALTY_FACTOR restored from 0.15 to vanilla's 0.25. The thresholds are UNCHANGED from the ruled ladder (15k/45k/135k/405k) so this batch isolates the two fixes; doubling them is BATCH B and runs separately.
_arms: events_fixed = {kind: config, config: config/mod_config.json} with research_events.enabled: true. Still a CONFIG VARIANT — enabled:false reproduces the plain techs arm from the same file.
_comparison: THREE-WAY, and the third leg is what makes it readable: (a) against run003 of 20260811_094048 (the `techs` arm, n=1) for the effect of having events at all; (b) against session 20260812_010659 (n=2 or 3, same arm minus the two fixes) for the effect of the fixes themselves. ⚠ Leg (b) confounds the two changes — the military gate and the ahead-of-time penalty move together and this batch cannot separate them. That is deliberate: both were ruled, and separating them would cost another ~5h of game time for a distinction neither ruling depends on. If the era-5 overshoot survives the penalty restoration, that separation becomes worth buying.
_watch: The specific numbers to re-read, all of which the previous session put on record: military's share of completions (was 70%); whether the top firing countries stop being micro-states; era-5 technologies held by the tree leader at 1935 (baseline 12/17 production, 1/15 military; previous events run 17/17 and 15/15); leader ÷ p90 (baseline 1.21 on both trees, previous events 1.14 production and 1.01 military); and manufacturing levels at 1935 (baseline 32986, previous events 26459/26373).
